Universal Research

A collected library for exploring how sound, vision and language modulate gene expression.

How to navigate

Choose a chapter or subchapter from the contents, or search papers by topic, gene, journal, physiology or study design. Select an article title to open the publication.

Trust Factor
At least 3 verified double-blind studies
At least 3 randomized or single-blind studies
At least 3 peer-reviewed journal articles

Individual papers: one cross for a peer-reviewed publication; two for a randomized controlled or verified single-blind study; three for a verified double-blind study. Each subchapter must contain at least three distinct qualifying studies to reach the corresponding level.
